articles.title: GHSA: HTTPX2: Conflicting Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers can be auto-generated
articles.summary:
### Summary

HTTPX2 can automatically add a `Content-Length` header to a request that already contains a caller-supplied `Transfer-Encoding` header. articles.title: GHSA: NLTK: Missing Post-Download Integrity Verification Allows Malicious Package Injection
articles.summary:
NLTK's package downloader in nltk/downloader.py does not verify file integrity after download and before extraction.

1. File is downloaded to a temp path via HTTP

articles.title: GHSA: NLTK: FileSystemPathPointer.open() sandbox check is dead code — arbitrary file read via file:// protocol
articles.summary:

There's a logic bug in `FileSystemPathPointer.open()` inside `nltk/data.py`
that makes the sandbox check permanently inert. The guard condition is always
`False` — meaning any file the process can read is accessible by passing a
`file://` URL to `nltk.data.load()`.

articles.summary:
### Summary
`nltk.corpus.reader.api.CorpusReader.open()` can be used to read files outside the intended corpus root via a symlink placed inside that root.
